vibe_rationale: Authentic open-access independent arts community, but centred on theatre and comedy rather than street, club or maker culture.
fit_notes: Large adult arts audience across three weeks, with a regional encore. Health precedent is real (VicHealth and a dental practice are partners), but the crowd is theatre and comedy led, so the wellness link is weak. Hub venues could host a lounge-style presence, and a development manager and partners page make the route open.
